## Build
- JDK 21, Maven from the repository root: `mvn -B -ntp verify` (use `./mvnw` if present).

## Security bumps
- Issues labelled `wiz-sca` are generated by wiz-connector from Wiz findings. Apply them with the
  `wiz-maven-bumps` skill (`/wiz-maven-bumps <issue URL>`): it lists exact versions-maven-plugin
  commands and acceptance criteria. Only direct dependencies are in scope.
